data.fund_name: Kotak Nifty SDL Jul 2026 Index Fund
data.fund_type: An open-ended Target Maturity Index Fund investing in constituents of Nifty SDL Jul 2026 Index. A relatively high interest rate risk and relatively low credit risk
data.investment_objective: The investment objective of the scheme is to track the Nifty SDL Jul 2026 Index by investing in SDLs, maturing on or before Jul 2026, subject to tracking difference. However, there is no assurance or guarantee that the investment objective of the scheme will be achieved.
data.asset_allocation: Replication of securities covered by Nifty SDL Jul 2026 Index - 95-100% - Low – Medium Cash and debt/money market instruments - 0 - 5% - Low
